reactor_identity_inference: Kuro reactor 2001 is taken to be MeowDB's Wooden Box (breakable 0000001): it is the only reactor that drops both Old Wooden Board and Rusty Screw for the Pio recycling quest (Kuro quest 1008; MeowDB quest 1012) plus Apple. Kuro reactor 1002009 also drops the two quest items; it is not on any MeowDB Maple Island map and is ignored.
egg_note: MeowDB lists Egg as a Wooden Box drop; KuroDB's Egg page lists no drop from reactor 2001. Egg's Wooden Box chance is unresolved.
